name: browser-use
headline: insights logger skill automation via claude
short_description: Automatically logs meaningful insights, design decisions, and edge cases during Claude Code sessions, preserving institutional knowledge in session files and CLAUDE.md.
author: nathanonn

sections.overview:
Build Insights Logger is a Claude Code skill that automatically captures non-trivial learnings during complex coding sessions, including edge cases, architectural trade-offs, performance considerations, API design patterns, and testing strategies. It writes these insights to session files stored in the .claude/insights/ directory, keeping a structured record of discoveries as they happen. After a session, an interactive review workflow lets developers select which insights are worth preserving long-term, then transfers them to CLAUDE.md as institutional knowledge. Completed sessions can be archived for historical reference. Developers working on complex or evolving codebases benefit most, as the skill helps prevent hard-won knowledge from being lost between sessions.
Preserving architectural decisions and trade-offs made during a complex feature build
Documenting unexpected edge cases discovered while implementing business logic
Tracking security and performance considerations identified during a coding session
Transferring session learnings into CLAUDE.md for long-term team knowledge retention
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/nathanonn/claude-skill-build-insights-logger`
sections.usage:
```
Create an insights logger for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The logger should track [DATA] and provide actionable insights. Include a summary section, key metrics, and recommendations. Format the output as a markdown report.
```
